scripts.prepare: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-web-bundle.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun --bun run vitest run --project node && vitest run --project react
scripts.build:binary: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && pnpm --filter @hydra/web build && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts && bun run scripts/gen-web-bundle.ts && bun build packages/hydra/src/main.ts --compile --outfile hydra
